name: Fatherhood Legacy
summary: Fatherhood Legacy is an immersive narrative that follows Bryson, a young gamer, as he clashes with his father, Booker, over his future. Through an emotional journey across the city and a meditation-induced flashback to Booker’s past, the two learn to communicate, discover their similarities, and begin overcoming their family’s wounds.
